First-day checklist

Confirmed items come from the economy page. Tip items are suggestions, not requirements. Progress is saved on this device.

The daily loop

Seeds from the shop, till and plant (uses energy), water and wait, harvest (no energy), then sell, craft or fill an order. Orders pay more than the shop. Energy refills 1 point every 30 seconds, even offline. Daily orders reset at 00:00 UTC.

Confirmed Ripe crops lose value: full harvest for 3 to 4 hours, then ¾, then ½, then they die 6 to 8 hours after ripening. Plant long crops before logging off.

Relic islands

Every Genesis Land has relic islands beside it: 1 on an Outpost, 2 on a Highlands, 3 on a Skyrealm. A relic placed on an island gives a chance of a little extra, up to a daily cap. Draft

  • Garden: 5% to 20% chance of +1 crop at harvest.
  • Livestock: 10% to 40% chance of +1 animal product.
  • Quarry: 5% to 20% chance to double a mining find.
  • Each island stops at a daily cap worth 400 to 2,100 gold, set by the relic’s rarity.
  • Supply per family is capped for good: 1,000 Rare, 150 Legendary and 25 Mystic. Relics come from keys.

Source: economy page. Relics switch on for Genesis Lands at launch.

Coming later for landowners

Guilds. Only Genesis Land owners can found one, and the land becomes its home. Member limits: Outpost 40, Highlands 75, Skyrealm 150. Anyone can join. Planned

Rift dungeons. Portals on Genesis Lands for parties of 2 to 5, with a boss every 5 floors. Depth by tier: Outpost 10 floors (Root Cave), Highlands 25 (Old Mine), Skyrealm 50 (Sky Rift). The owner hosts and gets a share of the loot. Planned

Plans only, with no dates, and the numbers can change. Source: Dev Log.

Limits and safeguards Draft

Daily limits

ActivityDraft limit
Task Board12 orders per day
Ronke Board6 regular orders per day, plus 1 rare-goods order for Genesis Lands
Deliveries8 per day, with one Delivery Cart per player
Fishing30 free casts per day, up to 50 total
WithdrawalsUp to 3 per day once mainnet withdrawals are available

Orders, deliveries, fishing and relic bonuses reset at 00:00 UTC. Energy restores 1 point every 30 seconds, including while you’re offline.

Before you can earn or withdraw $RONKE

The draft requires player level 5, a game account at least 7 days old, and a wallet connected in the game. Earned $RONKE has a 72-hour hold before withdrawal. Logins and trading volume do not count toward rewards.

The game server checks balances, pays orders, and verifies that each farm action has enough energy. Gold stays in the game and cannot buy past an unlock level.

Six controls on reward payouts

  1. Daily budget. The game sets a budget for each day’s rewards.
  2. Daily ceiling. A separate cap limits the total paid that day regardless of the token price.
  3. Player limits. Your reputation sets your individual Ronke Board limit.
  4. Reputation weighting. Reputation affects your share of the budget and the withdrawal fee.
  5. Circuit breaker. A surge in withdrawals, a sharp price drop (25% in a day or 40% in a week), or a low reward pool can cut the next day’s budget in half. The hold extends to 7 days, and large withdrawals wait an extra day. The draft resets these restrictions after 3 calm days.
  6. Reserve. Amounts held back by the ceiling and circuit breaker go into a reserve for weeks when the rate would otherwise fall below half the posted rate.

Checked 20 Nov 2026. Official safeguards · Daily resets · Ronke Board · Land-only order.

Editions, promo packs and Founders Season Draft

Genesis Editions

Genesis Editions are numbered assets tied to a season. They include animals, factories, boosters and cosmetics. Genesis Land owners can use them on their farms. The draft says anyone can buy an edition on Ronin Market after it’s minted.

Each Founders’ Barnyard pack contains one numbered animal. The draft lists a 12.5% base chance and a 533-per-season cap for each variant. When one sells out, the draft calls for an even draw among the remaining variants. The draft also specifies no duplicates until you own four different variants.

Gameplay guide

Rewritten in our own words from the official economy page and Dev Log guide, checked 20 Nov 2026. Where the two differ, this site follows the economy page’s draft. The game runs on Ronin’s testnet while testing, so RONKE in game is test RONKE. Draft

Getting started

You start with a small farm floating in the sky. Grow crops, raise animals, mine and craft, then fly down to Ronke Village by hot-air balloon to meet villagers, fish, play and trade. You earn XP from orders, planting, harvesting and mining, and levels unlock new items.

  • Energy: every action costs some. It refills by itself, 1 point every 30 seconds, and your maximum grows as you level up. You can also buy energy packs with RONKE.
  • Farm Store: buy seeds, trees, animals, buildings and tools with gold.
  • Marketplace: trade items with other players for RONKE.
  • Barn: your storage. It starts with room for 50 items and can be upgraded.
  • Construction: buildings take time, and you can pay RONKE to finish early.

Farming and energy costs

Till grass with the Hoe, buy a seed sack, plant, water with the Watering Can (crops only grow once watered), then tap to harvest into the barn. Other tools: Hand, Move, Ghost (see through tall objects) and Remove.

ActionEnergy
Till a tile2
Plant a seed1 (later seeds cost a little more)
Water a planted tile1
Harvest, or collect milk, eggs, honeyFree
Feed an animal2
Chop a tree2
Place a building, animal or tree, or start a mine run5
Craft (next update)3
Summon a unit8
Crops, feed and animals
  • Wheat makes cow feed; corn makes chicken feed; carrot, cassava and cabbage make pig feed. Feed is made at the Feed Factory (wheat or corn plus leaves).
  • Sugarcane feeds bees. An apiary with sugarcane nearby makes honey.
  • Other crops go to the windmill (flour), the kitchen and advanced recipes.
  • Cows give milk, chickens eggs, pigs pork. Pigs unlock at level 16.
  • Three fertilizers (basic, organic, premium) cost 60, 150 and 300 gold and make crops grow 10, 30 and 60 minutes faster.
  • Trees cost gold. How many you can plant depends on your land expansion. Chopping gives wood, fibre, sap and more for expansions and recipes.
Crafting buildings and Delivery Orders
  • Windmill: crops into flour.
  • Dairy (level 5, 3 levels): milk into cream (2 milk), butter (3) and cheese (4).
  • Bakery (level 9, 3 levels): nine baked goods from flour, eggs, honey, dairy and crops. They are worth much more than the ingredients.
  • Delivery Orders: the depot has three orders of 3 to 4 crates at a time. A filled order pays more than selling the goods, plus XP. Up to 8 deliveries a day, with one Delivery Cart per player.

The Dairy and Bakery were testers-first when the dev log was written. Draft

The mine

The mine unlocks at level 6 for 2,900 gold, with upgrades at levels 11, 18, 22 and 34. Finds depend on each mineral’s chance: Stone, Clay, Coal, Copper, Iron, Silver, Gold Ore, Crystal Shard, Diamond and Ancient Relic. Upgrading reaches the rarer ones, and minerals go into buildings, land expansions and recipes. Like fishing rods, mining stations wear with use and can be repaired with gold or a Repair Kit.

Source: economy page. Draft

Task Board and Ronke Board

Deliver resources to complete orders for XP and gold: 12 Task Board orders a day, plus one skip. Orders pay more than the shop, and rare ones pay RONKE. The Ronke Board has 6 small orders a day that pay RONKE by reputation, and its pool is shared if many farmers claim on the same day. Both reset at 0:00 UTC. Draft

Ronke Village
  • Getting there: use the balloon above your farm. During testing the village opens to invited farmers first.
  • Controls: click or WASD to walk, Shift to run, E to use things. Farm shortcuts: keys 1 to 6 pick tools, Esc puts one down. In the village, H goes home and T opens chat.
  • Market Mae buys crops, animal goods, nature finds and crafted goods for gold at market prices.
  • Fishing: cast from the pier. Fish go to the barn up to a daily limit. Skipper’s Bait Shop sells rods and bait and buys your catch.
  • Atsuga’s Decoration House: cosmetics and farm decor for gold or RONKE. The Golden Banana Statue gives a +5% chance of a double harvest (one counts per farm).
  • Bug Busters: Mido’s ten pest-defence jobs, with Easy, Normal and Hard levels. Harder pays more, up to double.
  • Arcade: four cabinets with high-score boards in the Hall of Fame.
Clash of Neighbors (raids)

Visit a neighbour’s farm and raid it. Raids happen on-chain and need a raid ticket, which can’t be traded and is used up. Win trophies to climb the rankings and earn weekly rewards. Train units at the Unit Factory (summon costs 8 energy).

Horske & Dogke racing

Two stadiums north of Ronke Village. Rewritten from the official racing guide, checked 20 Nov 2026. It was “testers first, then everyone” at the time. Draft
Betting can lose your whole stake. Bet for fun and only what you’re happy to lose. This is information, not advice, and nothing here predicts a result.

Loading the race clock…
Racing hours in your time

A racing hour starts every 3 hours at these UTC times, then the track rests for 2 hours.

Horske Stadium

8 horskes per race. 10 races in each racing hour, one every 6 minutes (minutes 0, 6, 12 … 54).

Dogke Stadium

6 dogkes per race. 5 races in each racing hour, one every 12 minutes (minutes 3, 15, 27, 39, 51).

How betting works

  • Betting closes 1 minute before each race. During a break, the first race of the next racing hour already takes bets. A race nobody bets on is skipped.
  • You back a runner to win, or to finish in the top 3, which comes in more often and so pays less. Every runner has a rating, and a higher rating means a better chance, but any runner can win.
  • Gold: fixed odds locked when you bet. 10 to 2,000 gold on one race, and one race pays you at most 25,000 gold. Winnings land on your farm.
  • HORSKE: real HORSKE from your own Ronin Wallet on Ronin mainnet. 11,300 to 225,000 HORSKE per bet (about $0.50 to $10) and at most 225,000 per wallet on one race. All bets on a race form a pot, and winners share it. You need RON for gas.
  • Claims: HORSKE winnings and refunds wait in the stadium’s RESULTS tab, never expire, and arrive when you tap CLAIM (a little RON for gas).
  • House fee: 10% of the pot, but never more than the losing bets, so winners never get back less than their bet. If nobody picked the winner, there is no fee and everyone is refunded.
  • Fair results: HORSKE races are drawn by Ronin VRF. Gold-only races use a secret locked in before betting, mixed with a Ronin block made after betting closes. The result relies on Ronin and its VRF service. If a race can’t be decided within 2 hours, it is called off and bets are refunded.
  • Limits while testing: each race’s pot has a cap, and the window says POT FULL when it is reached. Betting a HORSKE airdrop may affect eligibility for future airdrops.

Payout explainer for HORSKE pots

Shows how a pot is shared, with numbers you type in. It is not a prediction. The pot keeps changing until betting closes, so a real payout can be higher or lower.

Season Pass tracker (Founders Season)

40 tiers, and each tier needs 50 more stars than the one before: 100 stars for tier 1 up to 2,050 for tier 40, 43,000 in total.

Where stars come from

  • Daily tasks: 3 a day at 120 stars each. The RONKE PASS adds a 4th.
  • Weekly challenges: 7 a week at 400 each.
  • Farm work: up to 150 a day.
  • Task Board orders: 15 per order, up to 12 a day.
  • Ronke Board quests: 30 per quest, up to 4 a day.
  • Village season tasks: 5 a week at 300 each (fishing, Ned, butterflies, Bug Busters, a dig chest).
  • Logging in, buying and trading give no stars.

Reputation and fees calculator

Your reputation is your Ronke Score plus your Game Score. It sets your withdrawal fee and market selling fee, from 30% down to 5%, and your Ronke Board reward share.

BandScore neededGame Score neededFee
Newcomer0+–30%
Settler250+–25%
Farmer500+–20%
Trusted900+–15%
Elder1,500+400+10%
Ronke Legend2,500+800+5%

Game Score parts: account age (0.5 a day, up to 180), days played (2 a day, up to 700), level (10 a level, up to 500), quests and orders (1 per active day, up to 300), stake (up to 300: RONKE spent, or deposited and kept 30 days, in the last 90 days; a Genesis Land counts in full) and −500 for a confirmed flag. It tops out near 2,000. Your band updates once a day. Today the market fee is a flat 5% and withdrawals have no fee. How stake points are counted from RONKE isn’t documented, so you enter them yourself. Draft

Farm expansion planner

Each expansion step needs a player level, gold and materials from your mine, then takes time to build. Gold and RONKE can’t skip the level gate or the materials.

Mine materials aren’t listed per step, so they aren’t counted. Speeding up a timer costs 2 RONKE a minute. Today a free farm can still grow to 24x24, and the 15x15 limit starts at launch. Genesis Lands keep expanding past level 45, up to level 70 on a Skyrealm. Draft
